title: Billing-Error Supplement on Residential Natural Gas Supply Rebill Credits
content:
**Customer undertaking.** When the energy line of the most recent bill on a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement was over-billed, the billing-error supplement depends on the latest-bill over-billed amount: 10.00 when it is 20.00 or more, 5.00 when it is 5.00 or more but below 20.00, and no supplement when it is below 5.00. The supplement, in US dollars, is added to the latest-bill rebill credit.

**The amount it turns on.** The latest-bill over-billed amount is the line's billed amount minus the correct amount of that line when the difference is above zero, and nothing otherwise. A line with no over-billed amount earns no credit and so carries no supplement.

| Latest-bill over-billed amount (USD) | Billing-error supplement (USD) |
|---|---|
| 20.00 or more | 10.00 |
| 5.00 to 19.99 | 5.00 |
| above zero and below 5.00 | none |

### Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical amounts)

| Over-billed amount | Supplement |
|---|---|
| 20.00 | 10.00 |
| 19.99 | 5.00 |
| 5.00 | 5.00 |
| 4.99 | none |
